criteria.description: A user can choose a Hugging Face model card and pin a commit revision.
The selected model is registered as MLModel and MLModelVersion with source, license, task, format, and runtime requirements.
Artifacts and hashes are resolved and optionally mirrored to Blossom and/or OCI with provenance edges.
Placement selects a worker advertising vLLM, safetensors or Hugging Face snapshot support, NVIDIA CUDA, and enough VRAM.

The model deploys to vLLM, exposes an OpenAI-compatible endpoint through the existing gateway path, publishes deployment status/result and 31986 endpoint state, and records smoke evaluation/provenance edges.

coverage_notes: Criteria are mapped to executable D4 harness tests only for non-production behavior.

T-HFV-PROD-001/T-HFV-PROD-002 provide an opt-in production verification gate but are blocked in this workspace by missing real prerequisites (including expected model id and expected SHA-256 byte hashes for configured artifact/mirror bodies) tracked by bahia-wiw9 and package compile blocker bahia-iz8j.
No production readiness claim is made from fake/D4 harness evidence.
